Balances.description: Which balance-sheet amounts the ratios use (SPEC-0007 R2). No default: the analyst chooses.

oneOf.description: Balances at the end of the period (`closing`).
Average of the opening and closing balances: (opening + closing) / 2. Needs `opening`.

LiquidityBalances.description: Balance-sheet amounts at one date, in currency units.

cash.description: Cash and cash equivalents (part of current assets), in currency units.

current_assets.description: Current assets, inventories and cash included, in currency units.

inventories.description: Inventories (part of current assets), in currency units.

balances.description: Balances used by the ratios: `closing`, or `average` of opening and closing.

closing.description: Balance sheet at the end of the period.

opening.description:
Balance sheet at the start of the period. Required with average balances; not used
with closing balances.
